title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Premium Accounting: Overlap Credit on Confirmed Borrower Coverage
content:
Under the overlap schedule of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs**, the overlap credit returned to the lender when a certificate ends on confirmed borrower coverage is the figure defined here.

**(a) Evidence used.** The evidence used is the borrower evidence with the latest received date among the program's evidence entries that meet the acceptance rule, and the borrower's coverage start is the effective date shown on that evidence. When several acceptable evidence entries share the latest received date, the one entered first in the program's records is used.

**(b) Nothing to credit.** When no evidence entry on the program meets the acceptance rule, there is nothing to cancel and the overlap credit is zero. When the evidence used names no certificate, there is no certificate to cancel and the overlap credit is zero. When the certificate named on the evidence used already carries a cancellation entry, it has already ended and the overlap credit is zero.

**(c) Current term.** The current term of the certificate is the term on its latest renewal entry, or on its issue entry when it has no renewal entry; its premium, start date and expiration date are those on that entry.

**(d) Current-term overlap credit.** The current term's premium multiplied by the days from the borrower's coverage start to the current term's expiration date, divided by the days from the current term's start date to its expiration date, rounded half to even to the cent.

**(e) Overlap credit.** The current-term overlap credit, rounded half to even to the cent and never below zero.

Days between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date excluded and the later date included.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

- Current term on the certificate's issue entry: start 10 March 2025, expiration 10 March 2026 — 365 days; premium 1,212.00 dollars.
- Borrower's coverage start on the evidence used: 1 September 2025.
- Days from 1 September 2025 to 10 March 2026: 190.
- Current-term overlap credit: 1,212.00 multiplied by 190, divided by 365, that is 630.904…, rounded to 630.90 dollars.
- Overlap credit: 630.90 dollars.

## Points of judgement

- *Two acceptable evidence entries were received on the same, latest date.* The one entered first in the program's records is the evidence used.
- *The latest acceptable evidence concerns a loan on which no certificate was ever issued.* It names no certificate; the overlap credit is zero.
